title: App-owned /work-card skill; version bump is a per-project setting
notes:
The app installs its own /work-card skill, and the version bump becomes a per-project setting, off by default.

Why: the dotfiles copy of work-card (~/Workspace/dotfiles/claude/commands/work-card.md:40-45) bumps the version unless the project's CLAUDE.md says not to. Audit 13 removed that line here, because CI holds the rule (scripts/version-unchanged.mjs, workflow-rule-3). So every card shipped in this repo bumps package.json and CI fails the PR. The app is the only thing that runs /work-card (src/main/ship/ship.ts workPrompt), and it does not install it, so ship depends on a file outside the app.

Do:
- Ship work-card as an app skill, the way adopt-docs and create-task are installed (src/main/skills/install-skills.ts, skill-folder.ts).
- The bump step comes from a per-project setting, off by default. Off means the skill tells the worker not to touch the version.
- The checks come from the project's own lockfile/package manager, not a hard-coded npm/npx.
- Drop the lines that repeat the board instructions and the running-app guard: the app already holds both (BOARD_INSTRUCTIONS in src/main/workers/dispatch.ts, the board guard hook).
- Make sure the app's copy wins over a ~/.claude/commands/work-card.md of the same name, or say in the PR how they resolve. Deleting the dotfiles copy is a separate dotfiles PR; name the file in this PR's description.
- Docs and help: the feature's docs change in the same PR.

This card itself: DO NOT bump the version. The current dotfiles skill will tell you to; CI refuses it here.
